annotations.title: Albert Heijn: Add Recipe to Shopping List

description: Put the ingredients of an Allerhande recipe on the shopping list in one step. Each ingredient is matched to the AH product whose name fits it best (among equally good matches, one on bonus unless prefer_bonus=false); one unit of each product is added. Water is always skipped; pass skip for anything the user already has (e.g. olive oil, salt). Set dry_run=true to show the matches without adding them. Returns the added, skipped and unmatched ingredients, and any whose search failed (worth retrying). When you mention a product or recipe from the result, link its name to its url.

dry_run.description: Only show the matches; don't add anything

prefer_bonus.description: Prefer a matching product on bonus (default true)

servings.description: Number of servings, as in ah_get_recipe

skip.description: Ingredients to leave out, matched by name, e.g. ["olijfolie", "zout"]
